actions.description: Created a clean isolated worktree and branch at the exact PR #87 head because the primary checkout contains unrelated user changes.
Used public GitHub PR pages as a read-only fallback when authenticated GitHub GraphQL/REST calls returned transient EOF responses; no repository state was changed.

Installed pytest 8.4.2 and its dependencies only under the ignored task-owned .cache/pytest_runtime directory because neither available Python runtime provided pytest; no project or environment package was modified.
